scope: 16 historical development episodes, K8, two training seeds; no fresh confirmation, closed-loop or realtime quality admission

metrics.recorded: V9 fair energy_u, mean draw MSE/RMSE, mean prediction MSE, spread; no best-of-K
metrics.teacher: independent UniPC32 K8: two-sample energy U and mean teacher energy score; teacher is a reference above budget, not ground truth
metrics.uncertainty: paired episode bootstrap; same indices across configurations; training seeds separately and averaged within episode, not 32 independent episodes
metrics.selection: No selection; all four online64 students primary, two paired-seed means and all seeds reported.
metrics.primary_interpretation: Four raw command energy scores jointly displayed; no single weighted aggregate or retrospective winner threshold

reuse.rule: Reuse exact unchanged raw banks and original request seeds; fail on context/source/contract mismatch, no implicit resampling.

preparation_contract: Frozen native raw preparation, same paired_policy seeds as old controls; full declared native SDE1 and literal CFG1/4, zero action padding.
guidance_interpretation: Teacher CFG4 to student CFG1 is a new guidance-distillation comparison; CFG1 does not satisfy old literal CFG4 execution.
failure_policy: Preserve failed/partial evidence; no adaptive quality-based checkpoint selection or silent reference resampling.
